For centuries, the economies Of the South have been shaped by the economic policies applied in the North. These policies have been enshrined in economic theories. practices, and applications. often oversimplifying complex economies from the Global South. However. it is important to recognize that Africa, particularly Egypt, is considered the birthplace of civilization. Despite What Western books may suggest. during the era of slavery. it is worth questioning whom the North was trading with. When African nations are forced to adopt economic principles solely derived from Northern economic books. it can lead to the current global awakening and the animosity that the world is experiencing towards the Western and Northern regions. In this book. I present eighteen chapters that Offer a flexible perspective on what could potentially work for Africa and the South. These chapters cover various topics such as emerging markets, macroprudential policies. housing markets, climate economy. risk assessment in currencies. cross-border lending. monetary policy normalization, wage bargaining, quantitative easing, inflation targets, central bank policies, fiscal policy, climate change and central banks. fintech and financial inclusion, and the impact of COVID- 19 on cross-border risks. By applying the monetary policy Of advanced economies. this book applies monetary policy in advanced economies to better understand how developing economies like the CEMAC sub-region could be affected by economic policies implemented in the North. Its aim is to provide a fresh and uncompromising analysis that challenges conventional Wisdom and offers practical, context-specific solutions or Africa'sßconornic transformation. Text: THE SOVEREIGN SIGNATURE MASTERING CREDIBILITY CAPITAL MARKETS This new book is not simply the Story Of a president and a Country. It is also a true compass and practical guide for Africa and the world. It reveals, definitively. through proof. that the art Of sound financial management lies in the words "rigor and trust." which are ultimately the hallmarks of true wealth for nations and peoples. Under the leadership Of President Paul Biya. Cameroon has built a financial signature that transcends political cycles and economic turbulence. At a time when many African countries have faltered under the weight Of unsustainable debt, Cameroon has continued to speak the language Of discipline, balance, and stability. This account is at once a lesson in economic strategy and monetary governance. A historical testimony on the art Of building a state's credibility A visionary guide for future generations Of Africans called upon to defend the sm•ereignty of their nations through financial strength. More than just a book, this is a seminal work where financial science and political leadership converge to illuminate the future Of a continent undergoing profound transformation. In a world where market confidence has become as precious as gold. a Central African country has managed to establish its name and credibility On the interna- tional stage. This book recounts a unique financial and political saga: that Of a great statesman. President Paul Biya, who, over time. step by step. transformed Cameroon into a credible and respected player within the subregional and global financial community. TO such an extent that Cameroon. recognized for its numerous macroeconomic convergences. now inspires many countries and nations in their strategies for mobilizing resources in the global financial market. With the rigorous and inspired writing Of Professor Kelly Mua Kingsley. a leading figure in African financial engineering this book explores forty years Of reforms, boldness. and resilience. It recounts how. despite economic crises and geopolitical challenges, Cameroon has its reputation with investors. donors, and international institutions. transforming it into a business El Dorado and a truly z attractive destination.
